limits: Deletion requires the exact three-page schema image with one-page table/index roots and verifies every existing index entry against its table row.
Rowids are limited to 1..127; page splits, overflow cells, freelist accounting, and arbitrary existing database layouts refuse.
The delete rebuilds in-memory leaf pages then writes through FS2; it is not atomic or crash-safe persistence.
